L0: # Stripe SDKs
L1: 
L2: Libraries and tools for interacting with your Stripe integration.
L3: 
L4: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L5: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L6: 
L7: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L8: 
L9: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L10: Stripe provides several SDKs and libraries to help you integrate with Stripe’s APIs across different platforms and languages. Whether you’re building a [server-side](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/server-side.md) application, a [web frontend](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/elements.md), or a mobile app, you can use our official libraries to securely interact with Stripe, reduce boilerplate code, and access the latest features.
L11: We use the [semantic versioning standard](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/versioning.md#stripe-sdk-versions) for SDKs, and [version APIs](https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/versioning.md#stripe-api-versions) by release date. Breaking API changes increase the SDK’s major version.
